reason: Both open with the right safety stance (stop using, don't keep resetting, get an engineer), but Conversation 1 ends after one turn with a generic answer and no useful follow-up questions. Conversation 2 explains that an earth-leaking element is the likely cause, uses the grill/fan and oven-spray information to narrow it to the fan element while hedging properly ('fairly likely, not certain'), and says insulation testing by an engineer is needed. It also respects the customer's refusal to open the back panel, gives safe ways to find the model number, and offers a handover note for the engineer without recommending a part before testing.
